First impressions are everything. When guests arrive at our hotels, we want that impression to be memorable. The same goes for departures. When guests leave, we want them to go with a smile and a feeling that we were there for them throughout their stay. We want to build an experience that is memorable and unique from start to finish. Our Guest Arrival Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their arrival and departure experiences. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Arrival Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Arrival Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and objects weighing more than 75 pounds with assistance.. Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Arrival Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

d: Lead development accounting and commercial finance activities for development programs and projects, ensuring accurate financial reporting, cost governance, budget control, and financial performance management throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide financial and commercial oversight of development expenditures, commitments, forecasts, and investment performance to support informed decision-making and effective capital management.
Drive financial governance, compliance, and process excellence while supporting strategic development and commercial objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
CPA, ACCA, CA, CMA, SOCPA, CFA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
10–15 years of progressive experience in accounting, development accounting, commercial finance, project finance, financial reporting, or related disciplines.
Managing accounting and financial reporting activities for major development, infrastructure, construction, or capital investment projects.
Overseeing project cost accounting, capitalization, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
Supporting development feasibility, investment evaluation, and financial performance management.
Managing financial governance, audits, and compliance requirements within complex project environments.

r: Lead development accounting activities across assigned development projects, portfolios, and capital investment programs.
Oversee project cost accounting, capitalization processes, expenditure tracking, accruals, reconciliations, and financial reporting activities.
Manage development budgets, forecasts, commitments, cash flow projections, and financial performance monitoring.
Review and validate project-related financial transactions, contractor payments, consultant invoices, and capital expenditure allocations.
Ensure compliance with accounting standards, capitalization policies, financial governance requirements, and internal controls.
Collaborate with Development, Commercial, Project Delivery, Procurement, Treasury, and Finance teams to ensure financial alignment and reporting accuracy.

Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end development accounting activities and reporting requirements.
Prepare financial reports, executive dashboards, management presentations, and governance submissions related to development performance.
Coordinate audit activities and ensure the availability of accurate financial records, supporting documentation, and accounting evidence.
Lead and develop development accounting teams while promoting continuous improvement, automation, and financial best practices.
